name: line-item-form
title: Line-item form
description: Requests or items as lines — capex requests, hires, contracts — one unit at a time, with text and number fields, Add, and optional line approval (approvers tick a line; TM1 then keeps it read-only).

settings.heading: The title at the top of the screen
settings.subtitle: One line under the title
settings.cube: The cube that holds the lines
settings.fixed: { dimension: member } — other dimensions held at one member
settings.unit: { dimension, level, label } — what people pick (e.g. stores)
settings.lines: { dimension, level, label } — the numbered line slots (e.g. CapitalList)
settings.group: { dimension, level, label } — optional second line dimension chosen when adding (e.g. asset type)
settings.fieldsDimension: The dimension whose elements are the fields (e.g. Capital)
settings.fields: [{ member, label, type: 'text' | 'number', format, options: [...], required, width, long }] — the fields; long (or width ≥ 240) gives text a bigger box in cards
settings.totalField: A number field to total at the top right (optional)
settings.approval: { flag, by, at, process, approvers: [TM1 groups], params: { unit, period, version, line, group, action } } — optional line approval
settings.writes: The cubes it may change — normally just the cube
settings.runs: The processes it may run — the approval process, if any
settings.layout: 'cards' (one form per line, like an online form — good for requests with text) or 'grid' (rows, like a spreadsheet — the default)
settings.itemLabel: What one line is called, e.g. 'Request' — used on the + New button

example.heading: Capex requests
example.subtitle: One line per request · approved lines are locked
